status: DRAFT, unsigned. Lab-written probes for a lab draft; not a standard.
what: Inputs aimed at what JavaScript gets wrong by default (numbers past 2^53 and with exponents, repeated keys, prototype names, code point counting, unpaired surrogates, U+FEFF, U+2028, UTF-8 edges) and at the Unicode version gap of RECEIPT_v0.md 13.1. No expected answer is stored: a test runs check_v0.py and check_v0.js on each and requires the same answer and byte-identical canonical receipts, except on the probes marked unicode_gap, where the text pins no Unicode version and each host's decides.
